pairs.rationale: Brisket is a specific food; the broad Food title is not limited to its breakfast examples. Brisket does not encompass food generally.
Raw milk and raw-milk slush are foods in the broad dietary sense, including beverages. Food is not restricted to raw milk.

Making chicken stock is food preparation, supported by cooking, stock pots and chicken bones. Food Preparation and Dining is an umbrella for preparation and dining, not a requirement that every child perform both. Stock making does not encompass all preparation or dining.

The crockpot category specifies meat-based meals, and its masks describe beef stew and a roast. These fall within foods featuring meat or seafood; that broader category does not require crockpot cooking.
Grinding or roasting coffee beans is a specific coffee subject. Coffee as a whole is not restricted to bean preparation.
Appreciating coffee for flavour is a specific coffee subject, supported by decaf enjoyment and roast taste profiles. Coffee includes subjects other than flavour appreciation.

The fixed child title explicitly identifies satoshis as Bitcoin units. This is a narrower Bitcoin topic, not a claim that a unit is itself an entire cryptocurrency. Bitcoin is not restricted to its smallest units.

Roasting and taste-profile instances connect these subjects, but flavour appreciation also includes decaf enthusiasts without preparation. Grinding coffee beans does not itself express flavour appreciation. Overlap is not containment.
Photography and painting do not encompass playing music or a rave at a coffee shop. Music at coffee shops does not encompass visual art. The accepted Visual Art title is not being reopened.
Butter as part of a meal does not require meat or seafood; meat or seafood foods do not require butter. One shared shrimp-risotto instance is overlap, not containment.
Having consumed coffee is a specific coffee topic, directly supported by 'You’ve had coffee' and 'Just had'/'coffee'. Coffee generally is not restricted to having consumed it.

Meat eating is a specific kind of food consumption. The general food-consumption masks discuss eating many kinds of foods and dietary guidance; the meat category selects carnivore and eating gamey meat. Food consumption is not restricted to meat.
